milestones.title: Bare-metal bootstrap
milestones.acceptance: Workspace, linker script, vector table, reset handler and LED; demonstrate repository firmware blinking on hardware.

evidence.environment: Windows x86_64, Rust 1.100.0, thumbv7m-none-eabi release build from the M0 working tree
Three Blue Whales Elite ME V6, STM32F103ZET6, maintainer-reported hardware acceptance of the M0 working tree

milestones.title: Clock and logging
milestones.acceptance: Verify HSE/PLL at 72 MHz, HSI recovery for HSE/PLL/SYSCLK startup failures, USART1 baud and echo, log filtering, panic output, DS0, reset and debugger-free cold boot.
milestones.blocker: Normal boot, UART echo, DS0 and RESET passed. Frequency measurement, physical routing details, fallback, panic and debugger-free cold boot remain open.

evidence.environment: Windows x86_64, Rust 1.100.0, thumbv7m-none-eabi release builds and host verification

milestones.title: Interrupts and exceptions
milestones.acceptance: NVIC, SysTick and exception context; verify priorities and fault reporting.

milestones.title: Memory management
milestones.acceptance: Memory pools, optional heap and stack watermark; verify alignment, exhaustion and reclamation.

milestones.title: Task context
milestones.acceptance: TCB, MSP/PSP and PendSV; verify register preservation and stack integrity.

milestones.title: Real-time scheduling
milestones.acceptance: Fixed-priority preemption, equal-priority round robin, blocking and waking; measure latency.

milestones.title: Synchronization
milestones.acceptance: Mutexes, semaphores and events; test contention, timeouts and priority inversion.

milestones.title: IPC and timers
milestones.acceptance: Bounded queues and software timers; test full queues, cancellation and tick wraparound.

milestones.title: Device model
milestones.acceptance: Registration, capability interfaces and lifecycle; test resource conflicts.

milestones.title: Basic peripherals
milestones.acceptance: GPIO, buttons, EXTI, ADC, PWM and buzzer; verify on hardware.

milestones.title: Buses and DMA
milestones.acceptance: SPI, I2C and DMA; test timeouts, errors and buffer lifetimes.

milestones.title: LCD and touch
milestones.acceptance: Identify controllers, implement partial drawing and calibration; verify solid colors, text and coordinates.

milestones.title: Storage devices
milestones.acceptance: SPI NOR, EEPROM and SD; verify read/write integrity, capacity and power-loss risks.

milestones.title: Communications
milestones.acceptance: USB Device, CAN and RS485; verify enumeration where applicable, transmission, reception and recovery.

milestones.title: File systems
milestones.acceptance: VFS, FAT32 and optional LittleFS; test mounting, reads/writes, full and damaged media.

milestones.title: Shell
milestones.acceptance: Command registration and UART interaction; test input boundaries and error handling.

milestones.title: Resource monitoring
milestones.acceptance: Tasks, stack watermarks, CPU and RAM statistics; compare with measurements.

milestones.title: Graphics rendering
milestones.acceptance: RGB565, fonts, clipping and partial refresh; measure RAM usage and latency.

milestones.title: GUI and applications
milestones.acceptance: Event loop, widgets and static application management; verify touch and scheduling coexistence.

milestones.title: Rust SDK
milestones.acceptance: Public APIs, examples and version policy; verify standalone application builds.

milestones.title: C/C++ SDK
milestones.acceptance: C ABI, headers and toolchain; verify cross-language calls.

milestones.title: Loadable applications
milestones.acceptance: Assess relocation, ABI, memory and security boundaries; implement and validate only if feasible.

milestones.title: Platform portability
milestones.acceptance: Review architecture/HAL/BSP boundaries and document the second-platform porting contract; verify the active STM32 target where affected. No secondary-platform implementation or testing is required.
